component.name: fboard
component.summary: Soundboard that plays sounds through your microphone

description.p: fboard is a free and open-source soundboard for Linux. It plays sounds into your microphone so others hear them in voice chats and games, controlled by global hotkeys.

ul.li: Virtual microphone that mixes your voice and your sounds (PipeWire and PulseAudio)
Global hotkeys on X11 and every Wayland desktop, including mouse buttons
Categories, hotbar, instant search and sound lists
Volume normalization, block voice, hear myself
Auto Keys that press push-to-talk for you
